description: A Birthing Pod chain interrupted by a counterspell on the key combo piece - proves the simulator does not falsely recognize a win when a combo line is legitimately disrupted, and continues correctly modeling legal actions afterward.
artificial_state_elements: Seat 2 is a synthetic generic opponent constructed specifically to hold up and cast a counterspell on cue - not a claim about real opponent play patterns.
Exact hand/land sequence hand-selected to reach the disruption point cleanly.
material_characteristics: A countered spell never resolves - no permanent enters the battlefield and no enters-the-battlefield trigger occurs (CR 608.2b, CR 603.2)
Birthing Pod's search restriction (mana value exactly sacrificed value + 1) continues to apply correctly across multiple activations in the same game
The game correctly continues (no winner) after the combo attempt fails - a disrupted line must not be silently treated as a win
abstracted_characteristics: Seat 2's hand/board beyond the one held-up counterspell
Exact identity of creatures found by Birthing Pod beyond their mana values

actions.action: Draw step: skipped (on the play, turn 1)
Draw, play a land, pass, holding up mana
actions.notes: Constructed to represent an opponent holding a counterspell

actions.action: Draw, play a land, pass, holding up mana
Activate Birthing Pod (sacrifice Delighted Halfling, mana value 1): search for a mana-value-2 creature (Devoted Druid), put it onto the battlefield
Cast Hazel's Brewmaster, paying {3}{B}, intending to start the INT-0003 loop
actions.notes: No Devoted Druid in graveyard yet this game - this specific cast wouldn't have a target for the exile trigger even if it resolved, but is cast anyway to demonstrate the counter interaction

actions.action: In response, cast a counterspell targeting Hazel's Brewmaster
Hazel's Brewmaster is countered and put into seat 1's graveyard; its enters-the-battlefield trigger never happens because the spell never resolves and no permanent enters (CR 608.2b, CR 603.2)
Activate Birthing Pod again (sacrifice Devoted Druid, mana value 2): search for a mana-value-3 creature, put it onto the battlefield
actions.notes: Second Pod activation in a later main phase - independent of the first, no once-per-turn restriction on the ability itself beyond the permanent's own tap

actions.action: Pass turn with the combo unassembled and no attack declared

win_recognition_check: No state-based action for a win/loss condition is ever met in this sequence - Hazel's Brewmaster's countering prevents the INT-0003 loop from ever starting, both players remain above 0 life, and the simulator must correctly report the game as ongoing (not declare a winner) after the disruption.
rules_citations: CR 608.2b (countered spells go to the graveyard, never resolve)
CR 603.2 (triggered abilities require the triggering event to actually occur)
